items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Hartman was a singer in that band. ... Johnny Hartman was our singer.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was very lucky to be able to play. I played all the mallet instruments. They had two or three other drummers – a good band. Johnny Hartman was a singer in that band. We all know who Johnny Hartman was.
